description: Land Acquisition - Divulapitiya, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition and redemption matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land allotments being divested from state ownership, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
